records.sourceAnchor: Cooperative eligibility, healthcare activity scope, current NCDC application handoff, funding routes and conditional credit terms
observations: Ayushman Sahakar is a cooperative project-finance framework, not a universal grant. The applicant must be a cooperative society registered under a State or Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act with suitable bye-law provisions for hospital, healthcare or health-education services; an individual, private company or LLP should not be matched to this record as a direct applicant.

Eligible activity groups include healthcare and hospital infrastructure, AYUSH, medical/health education, diagnostics, telemedicine, digital health, health insurance subject to IRDA/accreditation boundaries, margin money and working capital. Each activity retains its own statutory permissions and appraisal conditions.

The scheme document states an eight-year loan period including a one-to-two-year principal moratorium. NCDC interest rates remain subject to circulars and amendments. A women-majority borrower cooperative may receive a 1 percentage-point term-loan interest reduction for the tenure only when timely repayments are made and current conditions are met.

Funding routes differ: direct infrastructure funding may provide NCDC loan up to 70 percent with at least 30 percent society share; State Government routes may provide NCDC-to-State loan up to 90 percent and a separate State-to-Society loan/share-capital pattern with minimum society share. The scheme document also provides security alternatives and allows possible subsidy/grant/VGF convergence, but none is automatic.

The current NCDC scheme index and common application route confirm that the operational handoff is activity/purpose and loan-type specific. Current rates, forms, contribution, security, State/direct route, processing, repayment and grievance details must be verified before an actionable recommendation.

UdyamVeda may prepare the cooperative, bye-law, project, permission, funding and security checklist. It must not promise sanction, calculate a guaranteed funding amount, act as a healthcare regulator, submit the NCDC form, or treat subsidy convergence as approved.
reviewFollowUps: Confirm the current NCDC guideline/form version, eligible activity, direct versus State route, current interest rate, margin, moratorium, repayment and security requirements.

Verify cooperative registration, bye-laws, project report, financials, society contribution, land/building evidence and all clinical, education, insurance, pharmacy, environmental and local permissions.
Separate NCDC loan, society contribution, State share-capital/loan, subsidy/grant/VGF convergence and women-majority interest incentive in the benefit model.

Obtain human reviewer approval for source, eligibility, benefit, application, window, fine print, amendment, current terms and factual accuracy before publication.
